object_description: compact smooth five-storey block with a constricted ground floor around a full-height air space
design_condition: the compact block occupies the entire depth of the perimeter but stays pleasantly restrained at the sides for increased spacing, its constricted ground floor forming the inviting main entrance towards the street

positive: The entire programme is combined in a compact five-storey structure with a natural-looking setting
The volume is pleasantly restrained at the sides in favour of increased spacing
A generous constriction of the ground floor forms the inviting main entrance
The ring-shaped circulation is organised around a continuous air space and two closed cores
Utility rooms are arranged at the same depth on all sides, allowing a high degree of flexibility
The ground floor is designed to be inviting and spacious
Cafeteria and media library are well located with access to the outside
The administration is efficiently organised on its floor
Break and copying zones provide access to the outside from the circulation areas
Learning zones sit in extended areas of the access zones on the facades and partly in the air space
The load-bearing structure is clearly and simply constructed as a reinforced concrete column and slab structure
Two continuous cores with facade columns take the main loads and bracing
The partition walls remain predominantly non-load-bearing
The volume is extremely compact with well-tempered surface ratios
The project achieves construction costs in the lower segment and meets the cost target well
A simple and convincing urban design with a clear internal structure and efficient, flexible organisation
Despite the somewhat introverted interior system it creates good operational conditions
negative: The main circulation with open staircases is not possible from a fire police point of view
It would require serious modifications and is not feasible in this form
The internal circulation is somewhat cramped and confusing in places
The relationship to the outside and to the connecting air space is limited
The proportions of the large classrooms are not ideal
The architectural expression is somewhat indeterminate for a school building
The cool interior atmosphere is more reminiscent of an elegant administrative building
It creates little specific identity for the school
The very high proportion of glass with additional solar control glass is striking and affects costs
